content.title: Plan-to-Execution Proof | Persistent Board, Escalating Results
content.summary: Keep a static plan continuously readable while a separate execution field completes its duties in order and accumulates visible consequences, then hold the final result beside the plan's last item.

quick_start.input_format: Continuously readable planning board + independent execution area + sequential advancement of the plan + at least three visible state changes + plan and final state in the same frame
quick_start.recommended_input: In an original miniature polar observatory, keep a five-panel brass mission plan fully readable along the left edge. In the larger execution field on the right, a ceramic survey automaton crosses three crystal stations, aligns a tilted lens and raises a folded beacon. A thin amber reflection appears on the ice, the plan remains fixed, and the final blue-white beacon aligns with the last plan panel while the automaton and all completed stations remain visible.
required_anchors: Establish one persistent planning artifact and one separate execution field in the opening.
Advance the execution field while keeping the planning artifact unchanged and readable.
Accumulate at least two further state changes while preserving subject identity, route and plan visibility.
Hold a terminal result with the persistent plan still visible for direct comparison.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Short-form sequences that keep a plan visible while a separate execution field completes ordered duties and accumulates proof.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Keep one compact planning artifact continuously visible and spatially stable while a larger execution field performs the planned stages in order. Let the execution accumulate real state changes and increasing consequence while the plan remains unchanged as an audit reference, then hold a terminal result that can be compared directly with the plan's final duty.

invariants.rule: Establish one persistent planning artifact and one separate execution field in the opening.
invariants.ablation_failure: A hidden or late plan turns the sequence into ordinary action footage.

invariants.rule: Advance the execution field while keeping the planning artifact unchanged and readable.
invariants.purpose: Makes progress measurable against a stable reference.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing both layers together destroys the audit relationship.

invariants.rule: Convert one planned action into a visible physical consequence inside the execution field.
invariants.purpose: Proves that the plan is being realized rather than merely displayed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Decorative motion without consequence cannot establish execution.

invariants.rule: Accumulate at least two further state changes while preserving subject identity, route and plan visibility.
invariants.ablation_failure: Disconnected spectacle makes plan and result impossible to compare.

invariants.rule: Hold a terminal result with the persistent plan still visible for direct comparison.
invariants.ablation_failure: Removing the plan before the result abandons the defining proof.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source gray cat and brown mouse
the source damaged domestic room, furniture and cardboard box
the source persistent nine-panel CAT vs MOUSE pencil storyboard
the source exact chase route and furniture-destruction order
FRAGILE, THIS SIDE UP and the beginnersblog.org watermark
